title: Enroll in E-Verify and verify new hires (Mississippi)
authority: Mississippi employment eligibility law / U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services
description: Mississippi requires all private employers to use E-Verify for new hires.

feeDetail.note: There is no fee to file or register.

penalty.note: No employer fine is stated; violations can lead to contract cancellation, debarment for up to three years and loss of the business license for up to one year.
